title: ProductCategoryProduct - Data API
description: Holds the relation between product and product category to assign products to a category. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

Catalog.description: The foreign key to the ProductCatalog ID of the Category.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

EffectiveEndDate.description: The date after which the catalog is unavailable to end users.

EffectiveStartDate.description: The date on which the catalog is available to end users.

IsPrimaryCategory.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPrimaryCategory.description: Indicates if the ProductCategory is the primaryProductCategory for a given product in a ProductCatalog. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

ProductCategory.description: Foreign key to the ProductCategory ID.

ProductToCategory.description: Concatenated Product ID and Category ID.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The lifecycle state of the catalog. Possible values include: Draft, Active, Inactive

special_access_rules: You must have the Industries, Retail, or B2B Commerce license.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ProductCategoryProductEvent (API version 55.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
